name: cp0x
tagline: cp0x is a community of crypto enthusiasts, developers, and builders united by shared values: permissionless access, open-source development, and putting users first.
values: Permissionless by design: financial tools should be accessible to everyone, everywhere, without gatekeepers
Open source over closed systems: transparency builds trust, secrecy breeds risk
User safety over yield: we would rather miss an opportunity than expose users to unnecessary risk
Long-term thinking: we build for decades, not quarters
what_we_do: Supporting project launches, managing vaults, curating risk, validating networks, participating in protocol governance, running trading competitions and educational initiatives, and building open, permissionless frontends for DeFi protocols.
